title: How an Air Purifier Works in 60 Seconds 🌬️✨ #shorts
description:
An air purifier is a fan pushing room air through layers of filters. A pre-filter catches hair and dust, activated carbon soaks up odours, and a true HEPA filter traps 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns before clean air blows back out. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#airpurifier #hepa #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A true HEPA filter traps *99.97%* of particles as small as 0.3 microns.

steps.label: Fan
steps.text: A *fan* pulls room air in through the sides.

steps.label: Pre-filter
steps.text: A coarse *pre-filter* catches hair, lint and big dust first.

steps.label: Carbon
steps.text: *Activated carbon* is full of tiny pores that soak up smells and gases.

steps.label: HEPA
steps.text: Then a dense, pleated mat of *glass fibres* snags pollen, dust and smoke.

steps.label: Clean air
steps.text: *Clean air* blows out of the top, and the room cycles through again and again.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Pull, *filter*, push. Follow Inside 60 for more.
